description_en: The fixed-line AXB privacy number binding restricts the calling relationship to a one-to-one relationship. User A can contact User B through the fixed-line intermediate number X, and User B can also contact User A through the intermediate number X. The fixed-line privacy number service is currently available by invitation only. Please contact your technical support to activate the service and obtain integration support
description_zh: 固话绑定AXB隐私号，是将拨打关系限定在一对一关系中，用户A可以通过固话中间号码X联系到用户B，用户B也可以通过中间号码X联系到用户A。固话隐私号目前为邀约制，请联系您的技术支持进行服务开通，并提供对接支持
kebab_example: aliyun dyplsapi bind-axb-fixed-line --app-id FC100000168480000 --ts 20161114143116123 --bind-type mode101 --order-id 1230000000 --tela '手机号：18200002371_固话：057100000036' --telb '手机号：18200002371_固话：057100000036' --subts 20161114143116 --anucode 1,2,3 --expiration 60 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BindAxbFixedLine

parameters.help_en: Business timestamp, in the format yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS. The time uses Beijing time, 24-hour clock, accurate to milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 业务时间戳，格式：yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS，时间采用北京时间，24小时制，精确至毫秒
parameters.name: ts

parameters.help_en:
Binding type. Valid values:

mode101: Customer specifies the X number.

mode102: Platform allocates the X number
parameters.help_zh:
绑定类型，取值：

mode101：客户指定X号码。

mode102：平台分配X号码
parameters.name: bind_type

parameters.help_en: Unique identifier for the message request
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en:
The A number in the fixed-line AXB privacy number.

The A number can be set to a mobile phone number or a landline number. For landline numbers, include the area code. No hyphen is needed between the area code and the landline number.
If your business needs to modify a bound number, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2883050.html API to make changes
parameters.help_zh:
固话AXB隐私号的A号码。

A号码可设置为手机号码或固定电话，固定电话请加区号，区号和固定电话之间不需要连字符。 
如果您的业务需要修改已绑定的号码，可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2883050.html接口进行修改
parameters.name: tela

parameters.help_en:
The X number in the fixed-line AXB privacy number. The X number is a privacy number you have purchased in the console (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/numberbuy).

In the customer-specified X number mode (i.e., the BindType parameter is mode101), this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
固话AXB隐私号的X号码。X号码是您在控制台已购买的隐私号 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/numberbuy)。

客户指定X号码模式下（即BindType参数为mode101），本参数必填
parameters.name: telx

parameters.help_en:
The B number in the fixed-line AXB privacy number.

The B number can be set to a mobile phone number or a landline number. For landline numbers, include the area code. No hyphen is needed between the area code and the landline number.
If your business needs to modify a bound number, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2883050.html API to make changes
parameters.help_zh:
固话AXB隐私号的B号码。

B号码可设置为手机号码或固定电话，固定电话请加区号，区号和固定电话中间不需要连字符。
如果您的业务需要修改已绑定的号码，可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2883050.html接口进行修改
parameters.name: telb

parameters.help_en: Binding time, in the format yyyyMMddHHmmss. The time uses Beijing time, 24-hour clock
parameters.help_zh: 绑定时间，格式为yyyyMMddHHmmss。时间采用北京时间，24小时制
parameters.name: subts

parameters.help_en:
Caller-side ringback tone code. Must be set for fixed-line AXB privacy number business. Must contain codes for 3 scenarios. Fill in the codes in the order of "B->X, A->X, Other numbers->X", separated by commas.

"1,2,3" means the ringback tone code for B->X is 1, for A->X is 2, and for other numbers->X is 3
parameters.help_zh:
主叫侧放音编码，固话AXB隐私号业务时必须设置。必须包含3个场景的编码。按照“B->X,A->X,其他号码->X”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

“1,2,3”表示B->X放音编号为1，A->X放音编号为2，其他号码->X放音编号为3
parameters.name: anucode

parameters.help_en:
Post-connection callee-side ringback tone code. Must contain codes for 2 scenarios. Fill in the codes in the order of "A as callee, B as callee", separated by commas.

"1,2" means the ringback tone code when A answers as the callee is 1, and when B answers as the callee is 2
parameters.help_zh:
接通后被叫侧放音编码，必须包含2个场景的编码。按照“A被叫,B被叫”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

“1,2”表示A号码为被叫侧接听时的放音编号为1，B号码为被叫侧接听时的放音编号为2
parameters.name: anucodecalled

parameters.help_en:
Post-connection caller-side ringback tone code. Must contain codes for 2 scenarios. Fill in the codes in the order of "A as callee, B as callee", separated by commas.

"1,2" means the caller-side ringback tone code when A is the callee is 1, and when B is the callee is 2
parameters.help_zh:
接通后主叫侧的放音编码，必须包含2个场景的编码。按照“A被叫,B被叫”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

“1,2”表示A号码为被叫时主叫侧的放音编号为1，B号码为被叫时主叫侧的放音编号为2
parameters.name: t_anucode_connect

parameters.help_en: Area code. Supports specifying the X number's region (specified city -> provincial capital -> nationwide routing). If no region is specified, a nationwide random number is assigned
parameters.help_zh: 区号。支持指定X号码归属地（指定城市->省会->全国路由）。不指定归属地，全国随机
parameters.name: areacode

parameters.help_en:
Expiration time, unit: seconds. Valid values:

0: Never expires.

Other values: When other values are specified, for example 60s, the binding is valid for 60 seconds after the X number is successfully assigned. After 60 seconds, it is automatically unbound
parameters.help_zh:
过期时间，单位：秒，取值：

0：永不过期。

其他数值：传其它数值时，比如60s，分配X号码成功的60秒内，绑定有效，超过60s后，自动解绑
parameters.name: expiration

parameters.help_en: External business extension field. This parameter will be returned in the call record receipt message. Must not exceed 100 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 外部业务扩展字段，通话记录回执消息中会回传此参数。不能超过100个字符长度
parameters.name: remark

fields.help_en:
Call recording control. Valid values:

0 (default): No recording.

1: Recording.
After enabling the call recording feature, you can play and download voice files in the call records. Recording files are billed at 0.010 CNY/minute per call minute
fields.help_zh:
录音控制。取值：

0（默认值）：不录音。

1：录音。
开启通话录音功能后，可在呼叫记录中播放和下载语音文件。录音文件按通话分钟计费0.010元/分钟
fields.name: callrecording
